full.name: Roland FP-10
img: Roland FP-10 88-key digital piano in black with small music rest
full.verdict: The best-feeling keys under $500, now 24% off: Roland's PHA-4 action, the same keys as the pricier FP-30X. This is the deal I'd grab for a serious beginner.

full.name: Alesis Recital Pro MKII
img: Alesis Recital Pro MKII 88-key digital piano in black
full.verdict: The cheapest 88 weighted keys I'd still recommend, now 19% off, with a sustain pedal in the box. Great value for occasional players.

full.name: Casio Privia PX-S1100
img: Casio Privia PX-S1100 slim 88-key digital piano in red
full.verdict: One of the slimmest 88-key weighted pianos you can buy, about 9 inches deep, now 18% off. Bluetooth via the included adapter.
cons: Touch controls take getting used to

compact.name: Donner DEP-20
compact.verdict: A budget brand, but a generous bundle: 88 weighted keys, a furniture-style stand and three pedals in the box. Key feel and sound are a step below the Roland, Kawai and Yamaha here; buy it for the complete setup.

compact.name: Yamaha P-45
compact.verdict: Yamaha's previous beginner piano, replaced by the P-145 in 2023: GHS weighted keys and a simple, reliable design. A fair price at 11% off, but the P-145BT has quieter keys and Bluetooth.

compact.name: Yamaha P-145BT
compact.verdict: My #1 beginner piano, at its normal price this week. Still the safest pick if you want it today; otherwise the Roland FP-10 deal is the better buy.

compact.name: Yamaha P-225
compact.verdict: The step up from the P-145BT: Yamaha's CFX concert grand sample, 24 voices and 192-note polyphony, now 16% off. Pick it over the FP-30X if you prefer the Yamaha sound.

compact.name: Roland FP-30X
compact.verdict: The FP-10's PHA-4 keys plus Bluetooth audio, 256-note polyphony and bigger speakers. Not on sale this week, so the FP-10 at 24% off is the smarter buy for most people.

compact.name: Kawai ES120
compact.verdict: Kawai's answer to the FP-30X and P-225, with Bluetooth MIDI and audio and Kawai's warmer piano tone. Not discounted this week.

compact.name: Kawai ES920
compact.verdict: Responsive Hammer III keys with let-off and strong 20 W + 20 W speakers. Not discounted this week.

compact.name: Roland FP-90X
compact.verdict: Roland's flagship portable: PHA-50 wood-hybrid keys and a 60 W four-speaker system. Not discounted this week.

compact.name: Kawai KDP120
compact.verdict: A real home piano with a furniture cabinet, three pedals and Bluetooth MIDI. Not discounted this week.

compact.name: Yamaha CLP-835
compact.verdict: The sweet spot of the Clavinova range: GrandTouch-S keys and CFX and Bösendorfer samples. Not discounted this week.

compact.name: Kawai ES60
compact.verdict: The best piano sound under $500, from Shigeru Kawai concert grand samples. At its usual price this week, but still my pick if tone matters most to you.
